# Receipt fixture boundary

These are synthetic fixtures generated by `node scripts/create-receipt-fixtures.mjs`. They contain no personal data. They do **not** establish support for any supermarket, language, OCR system, or AI model.

| File | Content | Verified use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| synthetic-text.pdf | Embedded text with rice multipack, weighted apples, milk, discount, and an ambiguous item | PDF structural validation, upload/hash identity and storage tests |
| synthetic-image-only.pdf | One stretched blank image, no embedded grocery text | Valid image-only PDF input; no extraction accuracy claim |
| proposal.json | Hand-authored expected example proposal, including unresolved quantity | Contract validation only; never returned by production parsing |

No real supermarket fixtures were provided. Automatic parsing remains disabled. Before enabling it, collect sanitized digital and scanned examples, choose/evaluate an embedded-text parser and a model, test the shared two-call/time budget and stale-attempt leases, and measure line coverage and field accuracy. The image-only fixture is not an OCR quality benchmark. Encrypted PDFs are rejected by the PDF library; a genuine encrypted-file integration fixture still needs to be added.
